bb-doha-1: With firm love and faith, one who prays with humble respect — Hanuman fulfills all their auspicious works.
bb-01: Victory to Hanuman, friend of saints! O Lord, please hear our plea.
bb-02: Do not delay your devotee’s work — rush and grant great joy.
bb-03: As you leaped the ocean and entered Surasa’s mouth, expanding within.
bb-04: When Lankini blocked the way, a kick sent her to the realm of gods.
bb-05: You gave joy to Vibhishana; seeing Sita you attained the supreme gift.
bb-06: You ruined the grove, cast foes into the sea, and broke death’s hold.
bb-07: You slew Akshaya-kumara and, wrapping your tail, set Lanka aflame.
bb-08: Lanka burned like lac; victory chants rose in the sky of the gods’ city.
bb-09: Why delay now, Master? Knower of hearts, show mercy.
bb-10: Victory to the giver of Lakshmana’s life! Destroy sorrow in haste.
bb-11: Victory to Hanuman, ocean of strength — foremost warrior among the gods.
bb-12: Om hanu hanu, steadfast Hanuman — strike enemies as with thunderbolt nails.
bb-13: Om hrīm Hanuman, lord of vanaras; Om hum — strike the foe’s heart and head.
bb-14: Victory to Anjani’s strong son, Shankara’s child, heroic Hanuman.
bb-15: Fierce face, destroyer of death’s hosts; always Rama’s helper and protector.
bb-16: Ghosts, spirits, ghouls, night-wanderers, fire-specters, deadly plagues —
bb-17: Slay them by Rama’s oath; O Lord, uphold the honor of the Name.
bb-18: By Hari’s oath let it be true — Rama’s messenger, seize and strike at once.
bb-19: Victory to unfathomable Hanuman! For what fault does your devotee suffer?
bb-20: I know little of worship, japa, or penance — I am only your servant.
bb-21: Forest, garden, path, mountain, home — by your strength we fear nothing.
bb-22: You are servant of Janaki and Hari — by that oath, do not delay.
bb-23: Victory resounds in the sky; remembrance destroys unbearable sorrow.
bb-24: Holding your feet with folded hands I plead — whom else shall I call now?
bb-25: Rise, move — by Rama’s call! I fall at your feet and plead.
bb-26: Om cham — O swift-moving one; Om hanu hanu Hanumanta.
bb-27: Om ham — the agile vanara roars; Om sam — wicked hosts flee in fear.
bb-28: Save your own at once; remembering you, our joy arises.
bb-29: Whom this Bajrang Baan strikes — who then can save them?
bb-30: Whoever recites Bajrang Baan — Hanuman guards their life.
bb-31: Whoever chants this arrow — ghosts and spirits tremble before them.
bb-32: Offer incense and chant always — affliction does not stay in the body.
bb-doha-2: With firm faith and refuge in the heart, whoever recites with attention — Hanuman removes all obstacles and fulfills every work.
